models.name: Heat rebuild
models.purpose: Fills heat for 1980 to 2024, so heat payouts have 46 years of history instead of 2.
models.use: In use before 2025, after matching its share of hot days to the measured 2025-2026 readings (9.0 rebuilt against 9.0 measured hot days in 2025): the raw scores here are before that matching.
